integrity: The proof gives an integral homotopy equivalence. Finite script checks are supporting consistency tests, not a substitute for proof; no independent external audit.
scientific_limitations: Assumes exactly two vertex-disjoint reversed edges in a simple bipartite graph; no classification for other orientations. A 3-fold homotopy suspension, not a homeomorphism or natural equivalence in arbitrary deletion maps. Literature equivalence risk remains.
title: A threefold-suspension theorem for two reversed arcs in bipartite multipath complexes
